h: Blac Chyna gets playful with ex Rob Kardashian during a live stream
p: Blac Chyna reportedly had a friendly phone conversation with her ex Rob Kardashian while live streaming, chatting about their daughter. Fans say the warm exchange surprised them.
more: The two have co-parented their daughter since their split.
Clips of the stream are circulating on social media.
